text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

- Police raided the headquarters of motorcycle gang Bandidos after a car bomb exploded outside the clubhouse of rival motorcycle gang MC Norway, which is associated with Hells Angel's, enemies of Bandidos.

- The environmental lobby in parliament has protested strongly against a decision by the government to give Naturkraft AS the go-ahead for the construction of the country's first gas-fired power stations.
- New Prime Minister Torbjoern Jagland had a new style in making his points in parliament yesterday, but his arguments were old.
- Private security company Securitas is expanding and will be moving into new headquarters in Oslo in July 1998.
- Norwegian oil company Saga Petroleum will be bidding for British oil company Santa Fe Exploration in the next few days.
